name: Dense shared geometry: task quality, exact reference cost and permutation variance
label: PILOT/DEVELOPMENT
rationale: The quadratic objective with cosine admits exact empirical product moments without a pair matrix. Test whether this enables useful dense correspondence training, without presuming a VCS task advantage.

theory.P: aligned pairs in the same scene/crop
theory.Q: full within-scene empirical marginal product, including diagonal
theory.J: EP T - EQ T - .5 EP T^2 - .5 EQ T^2
theory.reference_cost: Moment implementation O(N*d^2) work, O(d^2) moment storage; dense pair implementation O(N^2*d) score work and O(N^2) materialized scores. Descriptor/encoder memory and time remain additional.
theory.qualification: Conditional within-scene dependence; unchanged quadratic theory, constrained function class. Complexity alone does not imply end-to-end speedup or better registration.

controls.baseline128: Reuse all24 frozen clean geometry runs; no retraining baseline.
controls.sampler: Original128-position sampler drives crops and original positions unchanged. Stateless extra positions extend to2048, first512 nested. Extra ordinary permutations use an independent stream; all objectives share batches within each N.
controls.optim: Same AdamW3e-4, original decay/clip,3000steps,16scenes,crop160; no free critic. VCS/BCE/NCE formulas byte-equivalent in arithmetic to baseline.
controls.comparison: Same number of steps and CAL candidates, NOT same wall-clock budget. Across GPUs group times by model; use within-job probes for reliable objective cost ratios.

selection.rule: CAL macro loose-success, strict-success, lower median error, earlier step
selection.secondary: J_EXACT at the same selected model
selection.DEV: full existing clean DEV once per selected model; all Ns and seeds reported; no N winner selected on DEV

probes.data: One fixed FIT crop batch per dataset and trained seed; use clean CAL-selected VCS exact model
scopes: Objective forward plus descriptor backward on same GPU/input; synchronized timing, incremental peak allocated bytes.
Exact moment versus dense quadratic values and gradient identity.
Single/eight-permutation conditional descriptor gradient errors against exact reference; NOT total encoder gradient variance.
probes.note: No numerical DEV in probes. Existing guards may hash CAL/DEV inputs for integrity. No TEST.

endpoints: COS strict and loose DEV success and median error at each N, all seeds.
VCS exact minus permutation, BCE and NCE at the same N.
N512/N2048 minus N128 per arm; crops/initialization shared, more points also change P sampling, not just Q.
Per-unit synchronized training seconds, full completion seconds, peak allocated memory; hardware-stratified.
Same-device objective timing/memory ratios and conditional reference gradient errors.

decisions.expansion: This finite batch only. Do not automatically expand density, train length or learning-rate grid.
decisions.support: A useful operating point requires competitive task performance AND lower measured cost; report strict/loose failures rather than selecting a favorable metric.
decisions.null: Cheaper objective with no end-to-end or task gain is only an implementation advantage; no VCS application superiority claim.

limitations: More local points are spatially correlated, not independent new training data.
Fixed learning rate and NCE temperature may interact with density; no optimizer optimum claim.
Dense BCE/NCE are the existing full implementations; blocking/fusion could alter memory/time tradeoffs.
Repeated DEV is exploratory, not independent confirmation.

execution.estimate: provisional; gates and training time will refine
execution.prerequisites: CPU PASS, then BF and EPFL gates across all4 objectives and both Ns PASS; admit full batch only afterwards. No dependency jobs.

_publication_note: Public scientific protocol excerpt; not an operational freeze, source manifest or admission authorization.
